notes.subject: a hlohleletša
notes.rationale: הכעיס ke 'go dira gore a harege'; motho yo a hlohleletšwego ga a ngwalwa go Seheberu — Yahwe ke yena (kgauswi le difoko tša setopo)

notes.subject: תמרורים
notes.rationale: Lentšu le ka bolela 'bohloko' goba 'meuta e phahameng' (bamah tamrurim); KJV 'bitterly' kgahlanong le Geneva 'high places'

notes.subject: יטוש
notes.rationale: נטש le ka bolela 'go tlogela' (madi a gagwe a tla tlogelwa go yena) goba 'go hlatswa/thuntšha' — diphetolelo di fapana

notes.subject: sehlogo
notes.rationale: חרפה ke sehlogo/senyišo ya leina — mafelelong a moporofeta wa Hosea

translation: Efrayime o ile a hlohleletša bohloko bjo bogolo; gomme madi a gagwe a tla bea go yena, gomme Adonai wa gagwe o tla bušetša sehlogo sa gagwe go yena.
